print.name: Pencil Cup & Note Holder
print.summary: Remixed version of a pencil cup and note holder, optimized with a sleek design and cutouts to reduce weight.
print.description:
This is a remixed model of a pencil cup and note holder, originally made by an earlier maker over on another site. Thanks for a great model. 

 

I loved the look of the model, so I removed the logo, and made it so it can take a standard stack of sticky notes:

 

 

 

I also made a version of the model that can accept two stacks in the slot.

 

Print specs / details:

  • Printer: Example Printer
  • Material: Black PLA (default settings)
  • Supports: None
  • Layer height: .20
  • Brim: 8mm so it does not fall over, as it is quite tall

There are some overhangs in the slot where the note stack goes. I did not have issues printing those, but if you struggle with overhangs, you may want to use minor supports in those areas.

 

 

 

In the future, I may make a version that holds two cups, if there is a demand for that.
